title: Preservation of satisfiability under padding
statement: Let a conjunctive normal form on $r+a$ sign variables have at most $K$ clauses, where $a+3\le K$. If an assignment to the first $r$ variables and an auxiliary assignment to the next $a$ variables make the formula evaluate to $-1$, then extending the auxiliary assignment to $K$ coordinates with filler values $-1$ makes the padded formula evaluate to $-1$ as well.
hypotheses_covered: The formula is on $r+a$ sign variables
Its number of clauses is at most $K$
An assignment is given to the first $r$ variables
An auxiliary assignment is given to $a$ variables
The original formula evaluates to $-1$ on the combined assignment
